color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Start plan
model, remaining %, reset time, deadline, safety margin
answers expire after 24 h

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Specs in inbox/
headers: files, forbid, effort
coder: codex, claude or any
after: dependencies

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pre-run checks
subscription login only, clean environment
policy refusal of unsafe specs, hard caps

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Credit-aware scheduler
lanes run in parallel
'any' picks the coder with most headroom
daytime reserve kept

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Coder runs non-interactive
stdin closed, one spec at a time

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NightCoder gates
1 committed 2 remotes unchanged
3 diff guard 4 full tests re-run

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One fix round
then save to a backup branch
roll back, stop the lane

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Optional second opinion
masked, capped, advisory only

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
outbox/ patches + REPORT.md
STATUS page for phone and tablet

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
You review, then merge by pull request
NightCoder never pushes

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Usage limit
spec stays queued
wait for reset or stop quietly

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Purchase text or a coder-opened browser
kill the process tree, roll back
screen off, lane stays stopped until you acknowledge
